name: real-first-run
rationale: A6, the first real run, on a ~5 USD SOL-only wallet. Not for profit: it exercises the real path (quote check, tx inspection, fills, costs, ledger) about once an hour. JUP-SOL spends SOL, the only token the wallet has (a stablecoin can't be the bought token). Entry is a 1% draw per tick (live ~100 s); out after 10 min, or on a 1% stop of JUP against SOL; then 60 min of cooldown: ~1 round trip an hour, ~17 in the one-day TTL. 1.5 USD a buy inside a 2 USD budget, which must fit the ~2.6 USD left above the 0.02 SOL fee reserve. Worst case per trade is about the stop (~0.015 USD) plus costs; the bucket retires at -0.5 USD.
